design_philosophy: The Cosmic Void Navigator. An immersive, 3D-driven portfolio where the UI feels like a high-end cinematic terminal. Heavy use of negative space, micro-animations, fluid physics, and stark neon accents against void black.

hierarchy.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl lg:text-7xl tracking-tighter uppercase font-black

layout_and_spacing.grid_system: The Tetris Grid (Bento). Asymmetric layouts. Direct children of grid MUST have explicit spans.
layout_and_spacing.surfaces: Glassmorphism with heavy blur (backdrop-blur-2xl) and 1px sharp inner borders. No soft shadows, prefer solid 1px neon strokes on hover.

motion_and_interactions.hover_effects: Magnetic buttons, text glitch effects on hover, borders light up using Tracing Beam style.
motion_and_interactions.page_transitions: Cinematic stagger. Elements slide up and fade in with 0.8s duration, ease [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1].
motion_and_interactions.custom_cursor: Small neon dot that expands to a larger circle or 'VIEW' text on clickable elements.

page_sections.name: Header & Nav
page_sections.description: Sticky nav with glassmorphism. Left: 'CHANDAN GOWDA'. Right: Navigation links. Bottom border 1px solid white/10.

page_sections.name: Hero
page_sections.description: Immersive 3D scene (particles or wireframe). Massive glitch text 'CHANDAN GOWDA AH'. 'GenAI Data Engineer' typed out via typewriter effect. Neon CTA buttons.

page_sections.name: Stats & About
page_sections.description: Bento grid layout for stats ('3+ Years Experience', '10+ Projects'). Uses subtle noise texture on cards and neon numbers.

page_sections.name: Skills (Technical Arsenal)
page_sections.description: Terminal-style UI. Monospace fonts. Categories like 'GenAI & LLMs', 'Data Pipelines' glowing on hover with a scanline effect.

page_sections.name: Projects Showcase
page_sections.description: Grid of project cards with categorical filters. Cards feature stark black/white default states that reveal glowing neon elements or color images on hover.

page_sections.name: Experience & Certifications
page_sections.description: Career timeline with a vertical connecting line glowing like a neon fiber optic. Certificates display in a slow endless marquee.

page_sections.name: Contact / Footer
page_sections.description: Massive typography 'LET'S BUILD.' Links to LinkedIn, Email, Phone. Deep void background.

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: Write all React components in .js or .jsx files, NOT .tsx. We are using JavaScript.
Use pure HTML + Tailwind for complex layouts instead of restrictive Shadcn UI containers, to achieve the radical asymmetry and overlapping needed.
Implement a Custom Cursor component (e.g., a glowing dot that scales up on interactable items).
MUST use framer-motion heavily for scroll-triggered staggered text reveals, magnetic buttons, and page transitions.
Incorporate Lenis for smooth momentum scrolling. This is mandatory for the 'Godly' high-end feel.
Add a CSS noise/grain overlay (pointer-events-none) across the entire site to give it a cinematic, textured feel.
Ensure ALL interactive and key informational elements have 'data-testid' attributes (e.g., data-testid='project-card-1', data-testid='contact-email-link').
Use Orbitron for headings and JetBrains Mono for body and labels.
Use React Three Fiber for a 3D background if possible, otherwise use the provided hero_background_texture with a CSS scanline overlay.
